testcase.name: Integer exactness: integer delay, duration and local time give the exact stage and cycle and a once-rounded progress (section 6.3)
Phase precision does not depend on elapsed time: exact remainder, unlike frac(u / d) (sections 5, 6.4)
Fuzz: for every finite input the sample is valid, ACTIVE forward progress is below 1, nothing throws (sections 5, 6)
sample rejects non-finite local time (IAE) and an unrepresentable elapsed time (ArithmeticException) (sections 5, 7)
PING_PONG: odd cycles run backwards as (d - r) / d, values are continuous at every turn, the end value depends on parity (section 5)
Validation: finite delay, finite positive duration, cycles >= 1, ONCE has exactly one cycle (sections 5, 7)
LOOP: half-open cycles [n d, (n+1) d); finite cycles end in AFTER with cycle = cycles - 1 and progress 1 (section 5)
ONCE: BEFORE below the delay, ACTIVE on [0, d) with progress u/d < 1, AFTER from d on with progress 1 (section 5)
Delay: u = local - delay; negative delays start part-way; -0.0 elapsed time gives +0.0 progress (section 5)
TimingSample validates stage, cycle >= 0 and progress in [0, 1] (sections 5, 7)
Within one pass progress is monotone in local time: non-decreasing forward, non-increasing backward (section 5)
